input.quote: Except for Excluded Claims, each Party's total aggregate liability arising out of or relating to this Agreement shall not exceed the greater of the Fees paid or payable by Customer during the twelve months preceding the event giving rise to the claim and USD 1,000,000. The cap is mutual and applies regardless of the form of action or number of claims.
input.rationale: Meets our preferred position: mutual cap at the greater of 12 months' Fees paid or payable and USD 1,000,000, mutual consequential-damages waiver (with helpful direct-damage clarifications), and Excluded Claims covering confidentiality, data protection/security, indemnities, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud and IP infringement. 21.3 also confirms our payment obligation is not "damages" and is uncapped, and 18.2 confirms insurance does not limit liability.

input.quote: Vendor shall defend, indemnify, and hold harmless Customer, its Affiliates, and their directors, officers, employees, and agents from each third-party claim and resulting damages, settlements, judgments, penalties, costs, and reasonable attorneys' fees arising from an allegation that the Services or Deliverables infringe or misappropriate an intellectual property right.
input.rationale: Meets our preferred position: Vendor IP indemnity extending to affiliates (20.1), plus indemnities for breach of law, bodily injury/property damage, Customer Data breach and gross negligence/wilful misconduct/fraud (20.2); standard procedure in 20.4; infringement remedies (procure/modify/replace/refund) in 20.5. Our reciprocal indemnity in 20.3 stays narrow (unmodified Customer material and unlawful use) and indemnities sit outside the cap as Excluded Claims under 21.3.

input.quote: Nothing restricts Customer from developing, acquiring, licensing, selling, or using any product or service, engaging any supplier, hiring any person who responds to general recruitment, or conducting business in any field or territory. Vendor acknowledges that Customer has made no exclusivity, non-compete, most-favoured-customer, minimum-volume, or no-hire commitment.
input.rationale: No non-compete or field-of-use restriction binds us; 12.3 affirmatively preserves our freedom to develop, buy, build and compete in any field or territory. The exclusivity in 2.2 and the MFN in 7.2 conflict with this section but are addressed under EXCLUSIVITY and MFN respectively rather than double-flagged here.
